title: Hyssopus officinalis essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Hyssopus officinalis essential oil is a concentrated aromatic extract derived from the flowering plant Hyssopus officinalis, commonly known as hyssop. This oil is obtained through steam distillation of the plant's flowers and leaves, capturing its essential volatile compounds. In herbalism, it is valued for its antiseptic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory properties. It is traditionally used to support respiratory health, alleviate coughs, and treat skin infections. Additionally, it may be used in aromatherapy to promote mental clarity and reduce stress.
